audit_items.proof_trace: When `amount >= ceil(debt.amount)`, the full-repay branch calls `debt.cleared()` which sets `debt.amount = Decimal { value: 0 }`, making `has_debt()` return false; the subsequent `if (!debt.has_debt())` guard unconditionally calls `wit_table::remove`, removing the entry from both the inner Table and the keys VecSet. The partial-repay branch cannot accidentally zero the debt because `ceil(x) > n` implies `x > n` strictly, so `debt.amount - amount > 0` always. Both call sites (normal repay via `repay_debt` and liquidation at market.move:774) properly accrue interest before invoking `unsafe_repay_debt_only`.
